verdict.rationale: Circle documents its own fiat off-ramp: qualified businesses can use a Circle Mint account to convert USDC to USD at no extra cost, and a community commenter corroborates par redemption. The evidence never describes an automatic conversion of incoming stablecoin payments into a fiat balance or bank payout. CPN's fiat payouts are for sending money to receivers, not for settling a merchant's own receipts. Missing for 10: a documented auto-convert/auto-sweep setting for stablecoin receipts, a merchant crypto-acceptance flow that settles in fiat, bank payout configuration details, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can take crypto payments but settle in fiat — a documented option to auto-convert stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout so my books never hold crypto

citations.quote: Qualified businesses can apply for a Circle Mint account to readily convert USD to and from USDC at no additional cost.
USDC is backed 100% by highly liquid cash and cash-equivalent assets so that it's always redeemable 1:1 for USD.
Managed: Circle handles licensing, custody, compliance, treasury, and settlement on your behalf.
